verdict: Leads rising, cost per lead falling — but Google spend needs fixing now.
narrative: Over the last 28 days, you received 134 leads at a cost of $16.48 per lead, all driven by Meta — and the trend is moving in the right direction, with leads up 12.5% and cost per lead down 1.76% week over week. Google Ads, however, spent $532 this period and produced zero confirmed leads — this is a confirmed structural issue, not a tracking gap, and it is the top priority being addressed. Google conversion import is scheduled to go live by end of September, which will allow that spend to start working toward results. On the Google Business Profile, activity went quiet over the last 13 days and is being reviewed. Next period, expect the Google channel to move toward measurable output as the conversion path is completed.
